incidents.commentary: No run.
Full and on leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
No run.
Short and on middle, Mominul Haque defends it from the crease.

Full and on middle, Mominul Haque goes for the sweep and gets a top edge but the ball lands in the vacant deep fine leg region. It is mopped up by the fielder running around from deep backward square leg. Two runs taken.

Short and turning down leg, Mominul Haque thinks about tickling it fine but changes his mind. Holds his bat high to let the ball go past him. The ball brushes the thigh pad and it is collected by the keeper, Lorcan Tucker to his right.
Fuller and on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Sliding on with the arm, short and on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy hurriedly drops his bat down on the ball.

Shorter and pushed through, on middle. Mominul Haque hangs back to defend.
Tossed up, on off, eased back to the bowler.

FOUR! Not entirely in control but Mominul Haque will take it! Full and drifting onto the pads, Mominul gets down on a knee to sweep it behind square. Fails to roll his wrists over the ball on the sweep. It goes more of a top edge but through the vacant backward short fine leg region for a boundary.
Fractionally short, on off, Mominul Haque uses the depth of the crease to push it to cover.
Full and around off, Mominul blocks it out.
Full and speared in at the stumps, Mominul Haque plays it back to Andy McBrine.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, knocked to cover.
Short and a bit of turn, on middle, Mominul Haque crouches and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Short and on off, Mahmudul goes back and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Mahmudul Hasan Joy pushes it back to the bowler.
This is slower through the air but the length stays short, Mahmudul looks to flay it away but misses.
Flat and short, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy cuts it hard, but Curtis Campher at point dives to his left to save a certain boundary.
Short and around leg, Mahmudul clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy eases it back to Andy.
Flatter and shorter, on middle, Mahmudul pushes it back to the bowler.
Sliding across the right-hander, Mahmudul works this full ball to cover.
Tossed up, on middle, Mahmudul Hasan Joy gets forward to defend.
Short and on middle, Mahmudul presses back and jabs it to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed down to long off for a single by Mahmudul.
Floated up, full and on middle, Mominul sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
In and around the off stump, Haque taps it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Off the edge! This is fizzed through by Matthew Humphreys, short and outside off. Mominul Haque rocks back and goes hard on the cut. The outside edge flies well wide of Paul Stirling at first slip and the ball trickles into the fence.
Shorter and on off, Mominul Haque hangs back to keep it out.
Loopy ball, outside off, driven to cover.
At 83.1 kph, on middle and leg, Mahmudul taps it back on the deck.
Shorter and on off, punched wide of cover for a single.
Fired in at the stumps, Mominul Haque blocks it out with his bat close to the front pad.
Bowled from a bit wide on the crease, full and on off. Mominul reaches out in front for the block.
A bit of air given this time, fuller as well, on middle. Mominul Haque defends it off the front foot.
Pushed through, on middle, blocked out.
Short and quicker, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy defends it from the crease.

Keeps it short but bowls it slower through the air, on off. Mominul Haque is tentative in defence and hangs his bat out. Gets an inside edge that goes through the vacant backward square leg region for a single.
Short and wide on off, slapped to deep point for one.
Floated up, on off, knocked to mid off.

All of a sudden, the ball has started to turn! This angles into the right-hander, on a nagging length, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to defend with a straight bat but the ball straightens to square him up. The outside edge drops short of Paul Stirling at first slip.
Full and on middle, Mahmudul Hasan Joy defends it well.
Speared in, on the shorter side, on middle. Mominul Haque stays back to keep it out.
Short and on off, stabbed down on the off side.
Shorter and on middle, Mominul Haque blocks it out off the back foot.
Slows it down, fuller in length, on off. Mominul Haque reaches out and plays an uppish drive but well in front of the man at cover.
Shorter and quicker, on off, Haque rocks back to block.
Angled in from around the wicket, short and on the off stump. The ball lands and takes a bit of turn to catch the outer half of the bat as Mominul Haque tries to defend. It rolls away to point.
Full and on off, watchfully defended.
Darted in at the toes. Mahmudul Hasan Joy gets the front leg out of the way and tries to whip it across the line. Gets an inside edge onto the left boot.
Drops it short, on middle, Mominul swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single to open his account.
Turning in a touch, full and on off, Mominul Haque gets forward to smother the spin.
Very full, on off, Mominul Haque digs it out to cover.

OUT CAUGHT BEHIND! Ireland get the review right to break the opening stand! This is fired in by Matthew Humphreys, outside off. Not that short for the cut but Shadman Islam goes back and attempts the cut. The ball sneaks under the blade and the keeper, Lorcan Tucker stays low to cling on. Half a shout for caught behind but turned down. Tucker seems to have heard something and Andy Balbirnie has taken the review. Would you believe it? There is a spike when the ball is under the bat. Islam looks perplexed but he has to walk back. He falls for 80 (104). Bangladesh are now 168/1, trailing by 118 runs.
Stays around the wicket for the right-hander, full and on middle. This is eased back to the bowler by Mahmudul.
Short and on off, cut away to deep point for one more.

Way too short, at the sticks. The ball keeps a bit low but Mahmudul adjusts and punches it past cover. Matthew Humphreys gets around in the deep and tumbles away to his right to save a run for his side. Three runs taken.
Short and turning down leg, Mahmudul lets it be.
This is short, on off, it stays a bit low. Mahmudul Hasan Joy hangs back and glides it to the left of deep point for a couple.
Pushed through, on off and middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it out.
Drags the length back and hangs it up there, on middle. Shadman Islam presses forward and defends with his bat out in front.

Looped up, full and wide on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy firms the drive towards extra cover, where Cade Carmichael dives to his left and prevents the ball from going past him. Keeps the batters down to just a single.
Slower but the length stays short, on off, Shadman punches it to long on for a single.
Drops it short, on off, Mahmudul cuts it to deep point for one.

Flatter, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it back to the bowler.

In the air... but it lands safe! Short, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball lobs in the air and lands safely at square leg. The batters collect a single.
Full again, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it to the mid off fielder.

On a length, on leg, and it keeps low. Shadman Islam looks to flick it but the ball hits his pads and rolls to short fine leg. A stifled appeal but turned down. It looked like the ball had pitched outside the line. Ireland doesn't review this one. The batters collect a leg bye. The replay later showed that it had pitched way outside leg.

Much fuller, on leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy taps it to mid on.
Craig Young starts with a yorker, on middle, Mahmudul Hasan Joy digs it to mid on.
Slower through the air, on off, Shadman Islam pushes it back to the right of the bowler. That will be LUNCH on Day 2!
Too full, on leg, Shadman Islam flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short, on off, Shadman Islam rocks back and blocks it to mid off.

FIFTY up for Mahmudul Hasan Joy now! Keeps it full, on leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy sweeps it through short fine leg for a brace. His fifth test fifty!

FOUR! Mahmudul Hasan Joy moves into his 40s now! What a start this has been for the hosts. Short and wide, Mahmudul Hasan Joy makes room and slaps it through cover for a boundary.
Keeps it full, on off, Shadman Islam pushes it to mid off.
Short again, on off, Shadman Islam pulls it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! FIFTY up for Shadman Islam! Short and wide, Shadman Islam makes room and slaps it through covers for a boundary. His seventh fifty in Test cricket!
FOUR! Shadman Islam moves to 46 now! Short, on off, Shadman Islam goes deep in his crease and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Turn and bounce, outside off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to slap it but edges it through backward point for a single.
Around the wicket. Matthew Humphreys keeps it full, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy pushes it to the cover fielder.
Full, on off, Shadman Islam blocks it to mid off.

Quicker, on off, Shadman Islam blocks it back again.
Too full, on off, Shadman Islam blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! This is a brilliant start from the Bangladesh openers here! They are pouncing on any loose balls here. Short and wide, Shadman Islam picks it well and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, on leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy hops a bit and fends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Excellent from Mahmudul Hasan Joy! Short and outside off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy makes room and punches it magnificently in the gap through covers for a boundary.
Sways it down leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to flick it but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards the keeper. Dot.
Keeps it full, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy pushes it to mid off.

Wide! A wayward bouncer, outside off, Shadman Islam leaves it alone. Wide given for height.
On a length, on off, Shadman Islam drives it through covers for a brace.

Short, down leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy ducks under it.

Maiden. Quicker, on middle and leg, Shadman Islam leans on and blocks it to the on side.

Short, on off, Shadman Islam makes room and slaps it to the point fielder.
Much fuller, on off, Shadman Islam blocks it back to the bowler.

Slightly shorter, angling in, on off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy hops a bit and fends it to the right of the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off, Shadman Islam hangs back and slaps it through point for just a single.
A sharp bouncer, on leg, Shadman Islam ducks underneath it.
Length, outside off, Shadman Islam leaves the harmless delivery.
Goes fuller, down leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy stays back in his crease and turns it to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! That's a massive shot! A half tracker that sits up to be hit, Mahmudul Hasan Joy winds up and clatters it over cow corner for a biggie.
Much fuller, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it back to the bowler.

On a back of a length, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy tucks it wide of mid-wicket for a single.

Fuller and this slides down leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy swings to get it away but fails to connect.
On top of off, on a short of a length, Mahmudul Hasan Joy waits back to defend.
Jordan Neill sprays it down leg first up. Mahmudul Hasan Joy misses out on the glance.
On middle, Shadman blocks it out.
Speared in by McBrine, full and on middle, Shadman Islam knocks it to mid on.
Full again, on off, Shadman drills it to cover.
Full and on the pads, turned away to mid-wicket.
SIX! Good use of the feet! Tossed up by Andy from around the wicket, on off. Shadman Islam charges down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball. Lofts it back over the bowler's head for a six.
Floated up, on off, Shadman Islam firms the drive to cover.
Angled into the right-hander, on a good length, Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to flick it but fails to make contact. Gets hit high on the front pad.
On the pads, on a length, helped down to deep fine leg for a single.
On the off pole, on a length, Shadman Islam defends it out.

Much better from McCarthy! Goes wide on the crease on the around-the-wicket angle. Angled in on a good length, on off and middle. Islam hangs back to deal with it but gets squared up due to the seam movement. Gets it off the outer half wide of backward point. Cade Carmichael gives it a chase and slides to save a couple for his side.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Overcorrection on the part of McCarthy. Too full and on the off stump. Shadman covers the line and punches it to the left of mid off for four more.
FOUR! Put away with disdain! Short and wide on off, there to be punished. Shadman Islam hangs back and cracks the cut past point for a boundary.

FOUR! Gets it through! Andy McBrine looks to give the ball air but ends up being a bit too full. Dishes out a juicy half-volley, on off and Mahmudul Hasan Joy does not miss out. Gets his hands through the ball and thumps it to the left of the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Drifting onto the pads, on the fuller side, Shadman Islam clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A bit too full, on middle, Shadman knocks it back to the bowler.
Full again, on off, driven to cover.
Tosses it up, on middle, Shadman pushes this full ball back to Andy.
Sliding on with the arm, short and on off, Shadman Islam punches it off the back foot to cover.
FOUR! Thrashed! Barry McCarthy errs in line as he offers width on off, on a length. Mahmudul Hasan Joy climbs onto it in a flash as he frees his arms and drills it through covers for a boundary.
McCarthy hits the deck hard, over off. Mahmudul hops and steers it to backward point.
Short and wide on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy resists and offers no shot.
At 140.5 kph, on a nagging length, around the off pole. Mahmudul Hasan Joy shoulders arms.
Bowled from wide of the crease, aimed at the sticks, on a length. Mahmudul Hasan Joy pushes out in front of his body but gets an inside edge that goes through square leg for a couple of runs.
Lands it on a back of a length, outside off, an easy leave for Joy.
Pitches it up and pushes it across the batter, Shadman Islam leaves the ball alone.
On a back of a length, on off, Shadman defends it off the back foot.

At 128 kph, on a short of a good length. Shadman Islam does not quite commit to the pull and plays the shot half-heartedly. Gets more of a top edge but it drops in the vacant region between deep backward square leg and mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Fuller in length, on middle, pushed back towards the bowler.

Not far away from going to hand! Young bends his back and digs it in short, on middle. Shadman Islam is late on the pull and the ball gets big on him. It lobs off the upper half of the bat but falls short of Matthew Humphreys at mid-wicket, who dives in front but to no avail.
This is down leg, on a back of a length, Shadman Islam thinks about going after it but eventually decides to let it be.
Hits the hard length, over off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy rides the bounce and keeps it out with a straight bat.
In and around the off stump, fuller in length, Mahmudul Hasan Joy covers the off stump and makes the leave. The ball stays a bit low and carries around the ankle to the keeper, Lorcan Tucker.
Sprayed way down leg, on a back of a length. Mahmudul Hasan Joy offers no shot.
This moves away from the right-hander, on a good length, outside off. Mahmudul lets it through.
Serves it on a back of a length, on top of off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy stays back to defend.
On a length, outside off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy shoulders arms.
Low full toss, at the toes, Mahmudul Hasan Joy helps it down to deep fine leg for one.
On off, on a good length, stabbed down on the off side.
Good comeback from Young! In the channel on off and the length is pulled back. Mahmudul Hasan Joy pushes away from his body and the ball nips away to go past the outside edge.

FOUR! Sumptuous! Young misses his length as he dishes out a half-volley, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy presents the full face of the bat and with a high elbow, he drives handsomely to beat the diving mid on fielder to his left for a four.
On a shortish length, on middle and leg, Islam walks inside the line and shovels the pull to deep fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Shadman Islam is up and running! Angling away, on a back of a length. Shadman stands tall and punches it on the up through covers for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy gets away with it! A half-volley, on off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy drives firmly but picks out the cover fielder.
Full and sliding down leg, Mahmudul Hasan Joy is beaten for pace on the flick.
FOUR! This will help Mahmudul Hasan Joy feel a little better! A bit too wide and too full as well. Mahmudul presses on the front foot and cracks the drive through covers for a boundary.
Goes full and the ball tails back in, on the off pole. Mahmudul Hasan Joy just about manages to squeeze out an inside edge onto the pads.
At 135.5 kph, on a good length, on middle, bowled from wide of the crease. Mahmudul Hasan Joy is squared up as the ball straightens off the deck. Gets it off the outer half to gully.
Hurls it on a length, angled in on the off stump. Mahmudul Hasan Joy gets on the front foot and guides it to backward point.
Full and attacking the front pad, Mahmudul Hasan Joy presents a straight bat for the block. Ekes out an inside edge that goes down to deep fine leg for one.

Now Shadman Islam is keen for a single! Full and shaping away, Mahmudul Hasan Joy sees the width on offer and goes for the big booming drive. Gets an inside edge that rolls wide of square leg. Shadman is off for a run before Joy sends him back.
Drags the length back and this is around the thigh pad, Mahmudul Hasan Joy is beaten on the flick and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
Very full, on middle, the ball swings away late. Mahmudul Hasan Joy digs it out in front of cover and is once again eager for a single but his partner sends him back.
Moving away in the air, on a good length, Mahmudul Hasan Joy makes a watchful leave.
Strays down leg, on the fuller side, Mahmudul Hasan Joy misses out on the tickle.
Stays over the wicket for the left-hander and this is pushed across the batter, on a length. Shadman Islam lets it be.
Bangladesh and Mahmudul Hasan Joy are underway! Angled in at the hips, on a back of a length. Mahmudul glances it down to deep fine leg for a single to get off the mark.

A mix-up but no harm done! Barry McCarthy hits the deck hard, on off, Mahmudul Hasan Joy gets on his toes and taps it with a straight bat to the left of mid-wicket. Joy sets off and is almost halfway before being sent back. Matthew Humphreys gets rid of the ball quickly but Mahmudul manages to get home.

Beauty from McCarthy! Goes fuller and finds a bit of away shape, around off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy walks towards the line of the ball and has a slight feel for the delivery. Gets beaten on the outside edge.

Bashes the hard length, over off. Mahmudul rises with the bounce and drops it with soft hands in front of point. He is keen for a quick single but his partner sends him back and rightly so, as Cade Carmichael was quick to get to the ball.
A slightly wayward start from Barry McCarthy! Sprays it down leg, on a length. Mahmudul Hasan Joy swings to get it away on the leg side but misses.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Just too good for Barry McCarthy! Angled in from over the wicket, on a good length. McCarthy does not move his feet at all and stays leg side of the ball. Tries to cover the line of the ball by presenting a straight bat but the ball holds its line to go past the outside edge and clatter into the off pole. Barry falls for 31 (64). Ireland have been bowled out for 286!

Serves it on a short of a length, on middle. Barry McCarthy stands tall and jabs it through the vacant mid-wicket region. Nahid Rana gets around in the deep to his left and mops it up. Two runs taken.
This is angled in, full and on middle. Craig Young lunges to block but the ball straightens a bit to catch the outer half and it rolls to point.

SIX! Clean strike! Taijul tosses it up but ends up being a bit too full, on off and middle. Craig Young clears the front leg, swings through the line and tonks it back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Flatter and shorter, on middle and leg, Young stabs it down on the leg side.
Floated up, on off, Young pushes it to cover.

OUT! LBW! Matthew Humphreys falls for a two-ball duck! Loopy ball, full and at the sticks. A bit too full for the sweep and the ball sneaks under the blade of Humphreys. It goes through to hit the front pad right in front of the stumps. Ahsan Raza gives it long thought before raising his finger. Humpreys reviews but the UltraEdge shows no bat involved and it is three reds on Ball Tracking with the ball crashing into the middle stump. Ireland are 278/9.
Speared in from around the wicket, attacking the front pad, Matthew Humphreys defends it watchfully.
Hasan goes wide on the crease and slants it into the right-hander, on a length, Barry McCarthy miscues the drive to mid on.
FOUR! Fine shot! Mahmud pitches it up again and offers a bit of width on off. Barry McCarthy transfers his weight onto the front foot and drives it through point for another boundary.

Rapped on the pads! There was a double sound and Bangladesh decide against the review. At 138.7 kph, attacking the stumps. Barry McCarthy looks to defend it with a straight bat but the ball nips back in to go past the inside edge. The ball clips the front pad first before making contact with the back pad. Going down leg!
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Fuller in length, outside off, Barry McCarthy presses on the front foot and plays it right under his eyes. Plays a punchy drive through point for a boundary.
Honing in on the off stump, on a good length, Barry guides it from the crease to gully.

Nearly knocked him over on the first ball! Mahmud steams in from over the wicket and hits the deck hard. On a back of a length, on top of off. Barry McCarthy hangs back to deal with it but the ball jags back in to go past the inside edge and sails over the off pole.

OUT! LBW! Tossed up on middle, angling in and straightens off. Jordan Neill tries to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge and gets hit on the pads. Bangladesh appeal and up goes the finger. Jordan Neill reviews but to no avail, as the Ball Tracking shows THREE REDS. Bangladesh end the day on a high. STUMPS!
Stays very low, fuller and on off, Jordan Neill blocks it quickly.
Good running! Too full and outside off, McCarthy drives it through cover-point. Nahid Rana runs back and slides to save a run.

Floated on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Straighter line on the pads, McCarthy keeps it out on the leg side.

Flatter, on leg, Lorcan Tucker flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
